prompt: The client asks: "Should we drop our lowest-margin product?" Fact sheet: product X earns a 5% margin and is 10% of revenue; 60% of product X buyers also buy product Y; product Y earns a 45% margin; product X launched in 2015. Which is the best recommendation?

options.text: It earns only 5%, but 60% of its buyers also buy product Y at a 45% margin, so dropping it risks losing more profit than it saves. The main risk is that X keeps dragging down the overall margin. Putting it together, keep product X.
